headline: V.F. (VFC) Reports Q1 Loss, Misses Revenue Estimates
summary: V.F. (VFC) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -22.73% and -0.29%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
